title: Enterprise Cloud Migration and Modernization Services

teamingStrategy.rationale: TechForward's 8(a) certification, FedRAMP High ATO, and DHS past performance position us as the natural prime. Subcontractors fill targeted capability gaps in data migration, ServiceNow integration, and mainframe modernization without diluting our discriminators. Prime position maximizes our win probability and contract control.
teamingStrategy.sbTargetBasis: DHS OSDBU guidance mandates minimum 33% SB subcontracting for contracts exceeding $10M. We target 35% to exceed minimum and demonstrate genuine SB commitment. All three subcontractors are certified small businesses.
teamValues: Mission-first: Every team member must contribute directly to DHS outcomes
Complementary capabilities: No redundancy — each partner fills a specific gap
Past performance: All partners must have Satisfactory or better CPARS
Cultural fit: Agile, collaborative, low bureaucracy
Financial stability: Partners must demonstrate 3+ years of positive cash flow

prime.name: TechForward Solutions
prime.role: Prime Contractor — Cloud Migration, Security, DevSecOps, Program Management
keyContributions: Program management and overall delivery accountability

capabilityGaps.gapDescription: DHS has 340+ applications with complex data migration requirements including legacy databases (Oracle 11g, IBM DB2, Sybase ASE) requiring schema transformation, data cleansing, and validation for cloud-native architectures. TechForward's largest data migration was 180 applications at the Army — this effort is nearly 2x that scale with more complex data interdependencies.
capabilityGaps.impactIfUnfilled: Unable to credibly propose data migration execution for 160+ legacy database systems. Evaluators would identify significant risk in technical approach.
requiredCapabilities: ETL pipeline design for 2M+ records/day throughput

capabilityGaps.gapDescription: DHS OCIO mandates all cloud services integrate with the enterprise ServiceNow instance for ITSM, CMDB, change management, and incident management. TechForward has general ServiceNow experience but has not configured DHS-specific workflows, approval chains, or component-level routing rules.
capabilityGaps.impactIfUnfilled: Technical approach would lack specificity on DHS ITSM integration. Evaluators familiar with ServiceNow complexity would view this as a gap.
requiredCapabilities: CMDB integration with cloud asset discovery tools

capabilityGaps.gapDescription: 12 of DHS's 340+ applications run on IBM z/OS mainframes. These require specialized modernization approaches including application decomposition, re-platforming to cloud-native containers, and COBOL-to-Java conversion. TechForward has no mainframe modernization past performance.
capabilityGaps.impactIfUnfilled: 12 applications (~3.5% of portfolio) would lack credible migration plan. While not critical mass, evaluators may view this as incomplete technical approach.
requiredCapabilities: IBM z/OS application assessment and decomposition
Strangler fig pattern implementation for gradual migration

partnerPipeline.name: DataBridge Analytics
partnerPipeline.relevantExperience: Currently subcontractor on this exact DHS contract under Peraton. 4 years of DHS data migration experience with intimate knowledge of all legacy database schemas.

stageHistory.notes: Initial outreach — CEO receptive due to Peraton payment dispute
NDA executed. TA terms under negotiation.
Verbal commitment. TA in final legal review.

teamingAgreementStatus.keyTerms: 20% workshare, FFP basis, IP ownership retained by DataBridge for proprietary ETL tools

risks.risk: OCI concerns from incumbent subcontractor status
risks.mitigation: Formal ethical wall. No proprietary data transfer. Legal OCI mitigation plan.
Legal reviewed DataBridge TA with Peraton — non-compete expires with current contract period.

partnerPipeline.strengthForTeam: Irreplaceable DHS data migration knowledge. Their participation eliminates data migration risk and provides evaluators confidence in our understanding of the environment.
partnerPipeline.competitorInterest: CACI/Vertex has also contacted DataBridge. Our offer is more attractive due to higher workshare (20% vs 12%) and prime stability.

partnerPipeline.name: MainframeNext Inc.
partnerPipeline.relevantExperience: Completed 3 federal mainframe-to-cloud migrations including IRS and SSA. AWS Migration Competency partner specializing in z/OS decomposition.

stageHistory.notes: Identified through AWS Partner Network referral
Initial call with CEO. Interested in DHS opportunity.
NDA in legal review. Discussing workshare allocation.

partnerPipeline.competitorInterest: Unlikely to be pursued by other competitors. MainframeNext is a niche firm not widely known.
